posts.name: Numerous Times
posts.tagline: Inside Stories. Outside Proof. Independent business news
posts.description: A business publication for decision-makers. Operators, founders, and investors writing what they actually do. Most business news is filtered through editorial boards, corporate ownership, or slow newsroom processes. Numerous Times flips that: it's an open publishing platform where any writer or journalist can publish directly - no gatekeepers, no approval queue, no editorial hierarchy. Content is build to be shared for writers, it means a place to publish business journalism without approval.

posts.name: Wall of Certificates
posts.tagline: Your certificates, framed and shareable — one link.
posts.description: A free, personal tool for displaying the certificates you've earned — courses, diplomas, workshops, awards — as one page with a single shareable link. Auto-organized with AI-assisted titles, six wall layouts, a dozen-plus frames, and privacy that holds up: public/unlisted/private, PIN-protected walls, and real redaction that permanently removes sensitive details, not just a visual overlay. posts.name: FREED Tracker
posts.tagline: Turn your iPhone into a FreeD motion tracker
posts.description: FREED Tracker replaces external motion-tracking hardware with an iPhone or iPad.
